NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author updated the description with a prior-work section and a Co-authored-by credit, and left a cross-reference on #37289. There was no new push, and the author is asking for the label to be removed.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description now explains the relationship to #37289 and credits its author. |
| ❌  | #37289 is still open with "maintainer review", and @prakhar1144, its assignee, said on 2026-09-04 he plans to complete it this cycle. There is no sign the original author or @prakhar1144 agreed to this takeover. |
| ❌  | The plan promised before/after screenshots in light and dark mode, but there is one screenshot, no "before", and no dark mode. |
| ℹ️  | CI passes, but that doesn't settle the above. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready", and have the author sort out with @prakhar1144 and @CerealNotFound whether this PR or #37289 should go forward. If @prakhar1144 is finishing #37289, closing this one is the alternative.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Since #37289 is still open and @prakhar1144 said he plans to complete it, please coordinate with him and @CerealNotFound on that PR so we know which one should move forward, following the [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also add before/after screenshots, including dark mode, as in your plan.
```
